anomalies.observed: REG1 pin 1 (OUT) is on +3.3V, while the MCU rail net +3V3 contains decoupling capacitors, pull-ups, connectors and NAVC2 VBAT but has no REG1 node. Every FCC2/NAVC2 VDD pin appears only in single-node unconnected-(...-VDD...) nets.
anomalies.expected: The 3.3 V LDO output should feed the MCU VDD pins; the specification states that the 3V3 rail feeds both MCUs.

evidence.quote: 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: The MCUs receive no VDD supply, so the board cannot boot or operate; the two 3.3 V nets are not connected.

anomalies.observed: The navigation-side I2C nets NET0135 (SCL) and NET0078 (SDA) contain only the barometer, magnetometer, EEPROM, temperature sensor, IMU, pull-ups and test points; no NAVC2 pin is present. The GPS UART nets NET0150 and NET0014 connect U5 TXD/RXD only to the GPS_NAVC2 connector, with no NAVC2 pin.
anomalies.expected: The NAVC MCU should be connected to the navigation sensors and GPS receiver so it can gather IMU, magnetometer, pressure and GPS data.

evidence.quote: NAVC — gathers IMU, magnetometer, pressure sensor and GPS receiver data

anomalies.impact: The navigation computer cannot communicate with its sensors or GPS receiver, so navigation data is unavailable.

anomalies.observed: PCA9685 U3 pin 1 (A0) is tied to +3.3V, while A1-A5 (pins 2, 3, 4, 5, 24) are tied to GND. For a PCA9685 this forms I2C address 0x41.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the PWM/servo driver should have I2C address 0x40, which requires the address pins, including A0, to be low/GND.
anomalies.impact: Firmware expecting the PWM driver at 0x40 will not acknowledge it, causing servo/PWM control to fail.
